description: Record a note in the working object, in your own words. Offered, never required: call it at the moment something becomes worth a later turn's while.

content.description: the note, in one line, in your own words, as a later turn should read it

evidence.description: the line that shows it, if there is one, copied exactly from this turn's tool output or the user's message: the whole line or an unbroken run of it

supersedes.description: id of an earlier entry this one replaces; omit for a new fact

description: Say what became of an entry: settled, partly settled, the wrong entry, or replaced by something said since.

entry.description: id of the entry, as the working record shows it

verdict.description: done settles it; partial settles part of it; not_this: the wrong entry; superseded: replaced by something said since
